nary_nodes.label: Saudi Arabia and US conduct strikes in Iraq
evidence: Early Tuesday local time, it became clear restraint was no longer an option –– its fighter jets, along with US planes, carried out strikes across eastern Iraq.

Riyadh’s patience was exhausted. And early Tuesday, it 'conducted precise and targeted strikes' against militias in eastern Iraq 'linked to the attacks on petroleum facilities in the Kingdom', according to the Defense Ministry.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org Event class captures multi-party military strikes.

nary_nodes.label: Houthi missile attacks on Saudi oil complexes
evidence: At the weekend the Houthis fired missiles at two Saudi oil complexes on the Red Sea coast. Satellite images and geolocated video suggest extensive damage to one of those facilities, at Jazan near the border with Yemen.

The missile strikes followed Houthi attacks on two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea after the group announced a blockade of Saudi shipping transiting the Bab al-Mandeb chokepoint. The Houthis claimed a further attack on a Saudi vessel Monday.

nary_nodes.label: Saudi military capability improved since 2015
evidence: The Saudi air force is far more capable than 10 years ago, according to Obeid, in detecting, tracking and engaging dispersed military threats. It has integrated systems in a way that 'dramatically shortens the time between detection and engagement.'

evidence: Iran’s foreign ministry claimed again this week that 'some countries of the Persian Gulf independently participated in military attacks on Iran. The US is responsible for the attacks, but the role of some regional countries cannot be ignored.'
